newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lehman Bros see SHK Prop reach HK$110.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Bros see SHK Prop reach HK$110.

text.p: Lehman Brothers predicted on Wednesday the share price of Sun Hung Kai Properties would reach HK$110 in the next 12 months in line with an over 20 percent annual growth in earnings per share for the coming three years.

In its latest research report, Lehman Brothers said the EPS of Sun Hung Kai Properties for the financial years 1997 to 1999 would be at HK$5.72, HK$7.05 and HK$8.54, respectively, outperforming most of Hong Kong's property developers.
Lehman Brothers also put Sun Hung Kai Properties's investment in landbank replenishment in 1997 at HK$12 billion.
The net debt to shareholder funds of the company would remain one of the lowest in the sector at 10 percent, it said in the report.

Lehman Brothers said although the performance of the stock was sensitive to the movement of the U.S. federal funds rates, no movement in the U.S. short rates was likely and that no change to the underlying attractiveness of Hong Kong's property market.

"As Hong Kong's premier developer, Sun Hung Kai Properties is a core holding for any portfolio, the stock would be expected to be a beneficiary of any increased fund flows into Hong Kong," the report said.
The company shares rose HK$1.50 to end Wednesday at HK$98.00 on volume of 1.98 million shares worth HK$191.82 million.
